integrity: All proofs and enumerations given here are mathematical analyses with a standalone exact-arithmetic checker. No independent scientific audit or priority certification is asserted.
scientific_limitations: The statement is restricted to the five-dimensional torus evaluation code of the fixed cubic-scroll polygon over prime powers \(q\ge4\); it does not concern all scroll rational points. Finite computational checks cover five fields. Historical priority relative to the inaccessible full text of Yau--Zuo (2009) remains provisional. Hansen (2000) has a publicly verified month but not a verified exact posting day; the first_public_date is the earliest exact-day verified arXiv source among the identified motivating papers.
title: Uniform Hamming spectrum of the cubic-scroll toric code
